headline: Fresh Exchanges Stir the Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the line has shifted most visibly in MooringCountyHex, where seven strategic-base events were recorded in 24 hours and three in the latest two hours; all twelve bases are presently Warden-held. StonecradleHex has likewise seen fresh exchanges, with two events in two hours and nine across the day, leaving six Warden and three Colonial bases. StlicanShelfHex remains divided seven to two, but its daily total has reached 25 events, including one in the latest two hours. The great fighting at WeatheredExpanseHex and FishermansRowHex has eased in the immediate window: both show no events in the latest two hours, though Weathered has 43 daily events and Fishermans 39. Their casualty rates remain substantial, with enlistment activity accelerating over two-hour comparisons. MarbanHollowHex has also become a lively front, recording ten daily events and sharply rising two-hour casualty rates, while LinnMercyHex shows seven events and two in the latest two hours. Elsewhere, many sectors report no recent ownership action. No victor is declared.
